explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/690: 'Cambie [Ca25] has shown that d_k(p) is unimodular for 1 ≤ k ≤ 3'. The Lean statement: for 1 ≤ k ≤ 3 and any d : ℕ → ℝ recording the densities of kthPrimeFactorSet k p at primes p, IsUnimodalOnPrimes d holds, i.e. there is a prime m with d nondecreasing along primes up to m and nonincreasing along primes from m on. Using non-strict monotonicity is the usual meaning of unimodal ('increases until its maximum then decreases'). Faithful.
